assumptions_and_temporal_dependence_limi: Standard split conformal prediction guarantees finite-sample marginal validity under the assumption that calibration and test samples are exchangeable (e.g. i.i.d.). Because hourly bike rental counts exhibit strong autocorrelation, diurnal commuting periodicity, and seasonal non-stationarity over the 2011-2012 expanding horizon, exchangeability is violated. Consequently, the 95% target functions as a nominal coverage goal. Empirical coverage on the unobserved Test period achieves 94.84%, demonstrating robust empirical reliability despite temporal drift.
